author: Bobby Grayson
description: Add src/mcp/ module. New 'deciduous mcp' subcommand starts JSON-RPC 2.0 server on stdio. Direct Database access, no subprocess overhead. Single binary, zero new runtime deps. Functional core: pure functions parse JSON-RPC messages, build tool responses from DB data. Imperative shell: stdin/stdout IO loop at the edge.
title: Embedded MCP server via deciduous mcp subcommand
